modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 11 parts (23,936 triangles, three 2048 px textures). Rotated head-first, scaled to the previous Mosi footprint, merged into one skinned mesh on an 18-bone skeleton that keeps the old bone names and rest orientations, soft skin weights (each leg also moves the lower thigh or shoulder bulge above it, and the foot bones carry the feet), authored idle and walk clips (a calm four-beat walk with a 1.7 m stride per 2.917 s cycle and feet planted flat), textures reduced to 1024 px JPEG and the metal/roughness map removed. Built with lab/gfx-demo/tools/bake-mosi.mjs. The painted face replaces the fitted storybook eyes, the knitted scarf is left off, and the saddle and rider are refitted in dinosaurs.js.
